section.title: Sync devices
section.previewHint: This build can set up sync keys and approve your devices. Your data does not sync yet.
section.locked: Unlock this profile to use sync.
section.signedOut: Sign in to your Cognia account to use sync.
section.integrityTitle: The device list could not be verified
section.integrity: The sync service showed this device an older or different device list than the one it verified before. Nothing was deleted. Try again later, and contact support if this persists.
section.pollError: Could not reach the sync service: {message}

setup.title: Set up sync on this device
setup.description: This is the first device of your account. It creates your sync keys and a sync recovery key.
setup.spaceExists: Another device set up sync first. Ask it to approve this one.
setup.done: Sync is set up on this device.

join.title: Add this device
join.description: Your account already has sync devices. Approve this one from another device, or use your sync recovery key.
join.waiting: Waiting for approval. Open Cognia on a device that already syncs.
join.code: Check that your other device shows this code
join.expiresIn: Expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

ended.mismatch: The codes did not match. Nothing was added.

recover.title: Use your sync recovery key
recover.label: Sync recovery key
recover.mismatch: This sync recovery key does not belong to this account.
recover.invalid: That is not a valid sync recovery key.
recover.done: This device was added with your sync recovery key. Your other devices will see it.
recover.replacePrompt: Replace your sync recovery key now? Anyone who saw the old one could still use it.

recoveryKey.title: Your sync recovery key
recoveryKey.description: It adds a device when no other device is at hand. Cognia cannot recover it for you. It is not your profile recovery key.
recoveryKey.orDownloaded: I downloaded the recovery kit and stored it safely
recoveryKey.downloadFirst: Download the kit to use this option.
recoveryKey.wrong: Those characters do not match the key.

kit.title: Cognia sync recovery key
kit.intro: This key adds a device to your Cognia sync when no other device is at hand. Anyone with it can add a device to your account.
kit.step1: Store this file somewhere only you can reach, or print it and delete the file.
kit.step2: Never share it. Cognia support will never ask for it.
kit.step3: It is not your profile recovery key; keep both.

devices.title: Devices

addedVia.recovery: Added with the sync recovery key

devices.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from sync? It deletes its sync keys the next time it connects.
devices.fingerprintHint: Compare it with another device. If they differ, the sync service is showing them different lists.
devices.waiting: {count, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} waiting for approval
devices.keysUnavailable: This device could not open its sync keys yet.

removed.title: This device was removed from sync
removed.body: Removed on {date} by another device. Its sync keys were deleted; your local data is untouched.

approve.title: Approve a new device
approve.description: {name} ({platform}) wants to join your sync devices.
approve.codePrompt: Does the new device show this code?
approve.notFound: This request is no longer waiting.
approve.commitMismatch: The new device sent a code that does not match what it promised. It was turned down.
approve.expiresIn: Expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

notification.title: A new device wants to sync

summary.notInBuild: Account sync: not in this build

fleet.waitingBody: {count, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} waiting to join your sync devices.

errors.signedOut: Sign in to your Cognia account first.
errors.network: The sync service could not be reached.
